data.one_liner: Save images and videos to the device gallery on iOS and Android.
data.what_it_does: Saves images (from bytes, widgets, or network) and videos to the device's media gallery on Android and iOS. Supports custom subfolders, file renaming, quality adjustments, and skipping duplicate files.
use_when: You need to save captured widgets or downloaded images to the phone gallery.
You want to store recorded or downloaded videos in the device's photo/video library.
avoid_when: You only need general file downloading into app storage without exposing them to the OS gallery.
strengths: Handles custom path organization and skips duplicates.
Supports multiple image and video formats.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding photo library permissions to Info.plist on iOS and appropriate read/write storage or media permissions in AndroidManifest.xml.
